description: This file contains extension methods for configuring Redis-backed reminder storage within Orleans silo host builders and service collections. It defines methods to integrate Redis reminder services into the Orleans hosting infrastructure, including setting up dependency injection and configuration.

classes.name: SiloBuilderReminderExtensions
classes.description: Contains extension methods to add Redis reminder storage to Orleans silo host builders.

methods.name: UseRedisReminderService
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use Redis for reminder storage, by applying specified configuration.

methods.name: UseRedisReminderService
methods.description: Configures the service collection to use Redis for reminder storage, by applying specified configuration.
